name: Wirebar
author: TZV
description: Wirebar: WireGuard tunnels in the Omarchy bar. Connect, switch, import, rename, edit and QR-export NetworkManager tunnels, with live traffic and ping. No root needed.

barWidget.description: Left-click opens the tunnel manager; right-click connects your favorite (or last-used) tunnel, or disconnects the live one; middle-click refreshes.

schema.label: Connection name
schema.description: Favorite tunnel for right-click quick connect. Set with the star in the panel. Empty means the last-used tunnel.

schema.label: Ping host
schema.description: Address pinged through the tunnel for the latency readout. Empty picks the tunnel's DNS server or a host inside its AllowedIPs.
